label: Startup Debugging
description: Diagnose runtime, launch, environment, or process startup failures.

classifier.useWhen: User reports service launch, install, process, port, auth, or environment failures.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to design a new feature.

label: UI Runtime Debugging
description: Diagnose UI runtime, rendering, browser, interaction, or frontend workflow failures.

classifier.useWhen: User reports broken UI behavior, rendering issues, browser errors, or failed UI workflows.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks only for visual design critique.

label: API Runtime Debugging
description: Diagnose API, HTTP, webhook, auth, integration, or service response failures.

classifier.useWhen: User reports failed API calls, bad responses, webhook failures, request/response mismatches, or endpoint integration issues.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to design a new API contract from scratch.

label: Deployment Review
description: Review deployment configuration, release readiness, or rollout risk.

classifier.useWhen: User asks whether a deployment/release is ready.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to write unrelated prose.

label: Incident Triage
description: Triage outages, regressions, alerts, logs, or production symptoms.

classifier.useWhen: User reports an incident or asks for operational triage.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for normal feature planning.

label: Runtime Configuration
description: Configure services, endpoints, environments, or runtime settings.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to set up or change runtime configuration.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for conceptual explanation only.

label: Installation
description: Install, configure, and verify software on a local or managed environment.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to install a package, set up a runtime, configure endpoints, or verify local integration.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks only for written installation instructions.

label: Monitoring Setup
description: Plan or configure monitoring, alerts, health checks, and runtime signals.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to monitor a service or runtime.

label: Backup And Restore
description: Plan or execute backup, restore, recovery, or state verification work.

classifier.useWhen: User asks about backup/restore or recovery procedures.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for code refactoring only.

label: Release Execution
description: Execute or coordinate release steps, validation, rollback, and post-release checks.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to run or coordinate a release.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for release announcement copy only.
